components.css: .ds-product{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:64px;align-items:start;padding:0;background:var(--cyan,#44E0F8);color:var(--ink,#00384C);font-family:Noto Sans Thai,sans-serif}.ds-product-content{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;min-width:0}.ds-product-media{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;min-width:0}.ds-product h2{font-family:Kanit,Noto Sans Thai,sans-serif;font-size:48px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:600}.ds-product [role=tablist]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;width:520px;max-width:100%;gap:4px;padding:4px;margin-top:24px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.ds-product [role=tab]{min-height:52px;padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#183D49);font-family:Kanit,Noto Sans Thai,sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:500}.ds-product [aria-selected=true]{background:var(--ink,#00384C);color:#fff;font-weight:600}.ds-panels,.ds-product-media{display:grid;overflow-anchor:none}.ds-panels{margin-top:24px}.ds-panels>[role=tabpanel],.ds-product-media>figure{grid-area:1/1}.ds-panels>[hidden],.ds-product-media>[hidden]{display:block!important;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}.ds-product p{font-size:20px;line-height:1.8}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-product{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}.ds-product h2{font-size:32px}.ds-product [role=tab]{min-height:72px;padding:10px 8px;font-size:16px}.ds-product p{font-size:18px}}
